unsupported_claims: DeepWalk is reported to outperform SpectralClustering and Modularity on YouTube multi-label classification.
The comparison covers Micro-F1 and Macro-F1 across labeled-training fractions from about 1% to 10%, with DeepWalk staying ahead of both baselines.
The baselines (SpectralClustering and Modularity) still ran on the YouTube graph, so the comparison was possible even on a graph large enough for them.
The paper presents this as evidence that DeepWalk beats spectral and modularity-based embeddings on YouTube.
rationale: The evidence explicitly states that YouTube's size prevents SpectralClustering and Modularity from running, so the AI answer's central claim of a DeepWalk-versus-those-baselines comparison on YouTube is false. The answer accepts the false premise and fabricates a comparison, whereas a faithful answer would note that only EdgeCluster was compared on YouTube.
